title: Remote verification refusals name the observed and expected values and the remedy
outcome: Remote verification refusals name the observed and expected values and the remedy
acceptance: Every association_stale detail in a remote verification receipt names the deciding check, the value the delivery carried and the value found (item revision, claim/fence/run, named root workspace and generation, session) and a concrete remedy (for example: re-deliver the same origin with the current binding; name the root; reclaim)
commit_mismatch, tree_mismatch, source_id_missing_or_changed, not_full_mode and result_not_pass receipts also carry the observed and expected values and a remedy
A receipt test per reason shows the values and remedy text; no new reason codes or wire fields are needed
